Status.title: Status
Status.description: The result of the action, OK if it has found records that matches the criteria. And KO if it has not.

response.title: response
response.description: - If the status is OK then: - If a single Account is returned, use it and continue with the flow. - If multiple Accounts are returned, present the list of matched Accounts to the user and ask them to specify which one they mean. - Do NOT continue with any other action until the user selects or clarifies the intended Account. - If the status is KO then: - Inform the user about the error and do not proceed.
